# Kollects

> Kollects is a web app for building polls, forms and quizzes, sharing them with a link or QR code, and watching responses arrive live on a real-time analytics dashboard. Respondents never need an account.

Kollects is made for teachers, event hosts, community organisers and small businesses in India and elsewhere. Creators build a poll or a multi-section form (with branching, quizzes and file uploads), share it, and see results update live. Forms can collect UPI payments, and paid plans add a custom brand kit (logo, colours, fonts) and custom form links. Prices are in Indian rupees (INR).

## Product

- [Home](https://kollects.tech/): What Kollects does, how it works, and live usage stats
- [Features](https://kollects.tech/#features): Polls, forms, quizzes, live results, anonymous or sign-in responses, QR codes and branding
- [Pricing](https://kollects.tech/#pricing): Free (₹0, 1,000 responses a month), Plus (₹299 a month, 10,000 responses) and Pro (₹799 a month, 100,000 responses); yearly plans cost 10 months' price
- [Create a free account](https://kollects.tech/auth/register): Sign up with email or Google to start building polls and forms
